# Civify — AI Career Platform & Resume Engine

> Civify (https://civify.cv) is an AI-powered SaaS platform for resume building, multilingual CV parsing, ATS optimization, and job application tracking.

## Agent Capabilities & Tools
Civify provides tools for autonomous AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and REST APIs:

- **Resume Parsing**: Extract structured JSON from PDF, Word, or images with Arabic OCR support.
- **AI Tailoring**: Optimize bullet points and keyword density against target job descriptions.
- **ATS Scoring**: Calculate 0–100 ATS compatibility scores and identify missing skills.
- **PII Redaction**: Sanitize full name, phone number, email, and address for blind recruitment.
- **Job Scraping**: Scrape structured job requirements from LinkedIn, Greenhouse, and Lever URLs.
- **Application Tracking**: Manage user's application Kanban pipeline.

## Connecting via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- NPM Package: `npx -y @civify/mcp-server`
- Remote SSE Endpoint: `https://civify.cv/apis/mcp/sse`
- API Key Registration: https://civify.cv/settings/api-keys
- Developer Documentation: https://civify.cv/developers/mcp

## Pricing & Commercial Terms
- Free Tier: Basic ATS scoring, 5 CV storage, and watermarked PDF export.
- One-Time CV Pass: $2.99 USD (~150 EGP) for 30-day watermark-free PDF & DOCX export.
- Subscriptions: Starter ($4.99/mo) and Pro ($17.18/mo) with full REST API and unlimited matches.
